title: The summer wind
lyrics_plain:
The summer wind came blowin' in
From across the sea
It lingered there so warm and fair
To talk with me
All summer long we sang a song
And strolled the golden sand
Two swee-eet hearts and the summer wind
Like painted kites those days and nights
Went flyin' by
The world was new
Beneath a blue umbrella sky
Then slower than a piper man
One day it called to you
And I lost you to the summer wind
The autumn wind and the winter wind
Have come and gone
And still the days those lonely days
Go on and on
And guess who sighs his lulla bies
Through nights that never end
My fickle friend the summer wind
Summer wind
